description: This file declares the RequestHandler class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class manages lifecycle operations such as launch, terminate, sendIntent, and updateState, and provides access to component handlers like RuntimeManagerHandler, WindowManagerHandler, and IEventHandler. It also enforces singleton pattern via getInstance() and deletes copy constructor.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing lifecycle requests and component handlers within the plugin.

methods.name: RequestHandler
methods.description: Private constructor, initializes the RequestHandler instance.

methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.description: Initializes the RequestHandler with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the RequestHandler, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an application with the specified context and intent, targeting a specific lifecycle state.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates an application with the specified context, optionally forcing termination.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent within the application context.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the lifecycle state of the application.

methods.description: Returns the window manager handler instance.
